laCarcasse: An orbital wreck converted into a makeshift station. Reeks of sweat and molten metal. This is where it all begins.
portMeridien: A legal trade hub. Security agents everywhere. Smiling merchants who despise you.
lesBasFondsDeVega: Black market. Everything sells, everything's for sale. Your soul included if the price is right.
fortKharos: Military station. Regulated entry. The guards don't joke around, and the cannons are always loaded.
nexusAldara: Technological crossroads. The best hackers and engineers live here — or die here.
arcOuestApocalypse: Alanossa's territory. No one enters without permission. No one leaves without scars.
lePurgatoire: A former prison, repurposed. The jailers left. The inhabitants stayed. That's all you need to know.
leNidDesFaucons: Headquarters of the Black Falcons. Clean, militarized, deadly.
fortOssian: A frontier fortress. Rotating soldiers, front-line atmosphere. Nothing gets in easily.
colonnePersephone: An agricultural colony. Calm on the surface. Deep tensions underground.
stationRocaille: A mining station on an asteroid. The miners are tough. The prices are tough. Everything's tough.
laForgeNoire: An illegal floating factory. They make weapons without a license. Excellent weapons.
entrepotZero: A giant space warehouse no one claims ownership of. Perfect for hiding things.
emporiumRequiem: Cesarion's artificial planet. Strict customs, an omnipresent army — but the sector's best arms dealers are here. Access must be earned.
starQuest: A leisure station for the wealthy. Combat arenas, private clinics, exclusive entertainment. The casino belongs to Scotty — here, people gamble differently.
laCitadelleEcarlate: Stronghold of the Scarlet Falcons. A rival faction to the Black Falcons. Just as violent.
lesAbyssesDeVelkor: An abandoned research station, repurposed by exiles. Dark. Dangerous. Fascinating.
scottyGoldenNorth: Samy Scotty's kingdom. Casino, gambling, bets on everything and anything — this is where the sector's credits end up. Far from everywhere, but very real.
laCouronneDEos: A prestigious orbital station. Elites gather here to decide the fate of others.
lePerchoir: A Falcon outpost on an asteroid. Small, dark, always watched.
stationOmbre: A clandestine Falcon operations base. Officially nonexistent.
relaisNoir: A Falcon supply point. Open to those who know how to ask.
laTaniere: A former pirate hideout, taken over by Alanossa. Absolute loyalty required to enter.
fortDeCendres: A Falcon fort built on the ruins of a military outpost. Black walls. Efficient soldiers.
loeilDuFaucon: An observation and listening station. The Falcons see everything from here — or nearly.
repaireVegaSud: A criminal satellite of the Bas-Fonds. What's too risky up there ends up here.
bastionMineur: A secondary Guardian garrison. Less imposing than the Citadel. Just as serious.
posteVigie: A Guardian watch post at the edge of their territory. A lookout, two soldiers, a spyglass.
arsenalEcarlate: The Guardians' weapons depot. Better guarded than some banks.
forteresseExilee: A former Guardian fort whose occupants were exiled. Someone else took it over.
comptoirSud: The Emporium's trade outpost. More accessible. Less well stocked.
annexeCommerciale: The Emporium's representative office. Presentable. Discreet. Useful.
relaisDeTransit: The Emporium's logistics hub. Goods pass through. So do secrets.
residenceOrbitale: Private housing for the orbital elite. Discreet but total security.
clubPriveEos: A meeting lounge for decision-makers. Invitation-only. What's said here doesn't leave.
lesCendres: What remains of a destroyed station. Someone burned it. Someone lives here anyway.
stationQuarantaine: Quarantined twenty years ago. Officially lifted. The people who stayed, not so much.
leBerceau: An ancient station — predating all current conflicts. Something began here.
epaveVivante: A giant orbiting cargo ship turned station through human accumulation. It holds together because it always has.
stationFantome: Officially empty for ten years. Signals coming from here are officially interference.
oasisDeFer: A neutral zone guaranteed by agreement between rival factions. No one shoots here — too much at stake.
laBalise: A navigation station. A guiding signal for every pilot in the sector.
confluent: A crossroads of trade routes. Neither rich nor poor. Just smack in the middle of everything.
portDeNuit: A floating night market. Everything the Bas-Fonds sells officially, Port de Nuit sells discreetly.
leGrandBazar: A gigantic, neutral market-world where everything used to build things is sold. Endless aisles of materials, components, and resources. One rule: here you sell what you need to BUILD, never ready-made weapons.
stationZephyr: Atmospheric research on nearby gas giants. Brilliant scientists. Minimal security.
observatoire: A deep-void observation station. Too far from everything for anything to happen here.
stationLimite: The last mapped outpost. Pilots who go further don't always come back.
cavernesDeMira: Galleries carved into a massive asteroid. The miners found something other than ore. They don't talk about it.
laRaffinerie: An orbital refining platform. Heat, noise, output. Workers leave changed.
arcPerdu: A drifting fragment of the old main station, abandoned since the Great War. Once held the most dangerous soldiers — and a general who never came back. Or did he.
laTribosphere: Eliotis's festive planet. Everyone is welcome — except those who come to disturb the party. That last part is enforced with military precision.
paradoxaEterna: King Maxance's planet, covered in extraordinary wildlife and flora. Pacifist — but closed to notorious criminals. The rare fruits grown here are legendary for their effects.
areneDeKorsun: A legalized combat station. Shouting stands, corridors that smell of blood and resin. The only place where dying in public counts as entertainment.
portDesBrumes: The port owes its name to the constant fumes from its faulty recyclers. No one has ever fixed them. The mist hides hands and jams cameras — it's functional.
forgeAlpha: An industrial complex that never stops. Three rotating shifts, every idle second a loss. Workers talk in gestures between the machines.
sanctuaireDesDerives: The only place in the sector where no one carries a visible weapon. Sister Valkara wanted it that way. The rule holds not by force but by consensus — no one comes here to fight.
sanctumMachina: Robots are everywhere. ARIA-9, the central AI, coordinates them in real time. At the entrance, your profile is built in eight seconds. It's already assessed you.
laBulle: A biomedical research station with creatively diversified activities. Doctor Flinch understood that legal and illegal were the same market. His clean clinics sit alongside back rooms whose equipment is too precise to be honest.
laForgeDesDamnes: Produces weapons the official catalogs don't list. Armorer Skade works on commission, no questions asked. Her weapons carry no serial numbers. That's not a flaw.
